Its gallery captions and article text identify Sonobot 5 in the unit context, providing exact official identity evidence.

entries.system_name: GCS-200 — těžká dálkově řízená odminovací platforma v Ukrajině
entries.source_title: This year, 26 more GCS mechanized demining machines will be delivered to Ukraine
entries.identity_evidence: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence article dated 3 March 2025 explicitly states that 62 GCS-200 mechanized demining machines were operating in Ukraine and describes GCS-200 as an unmanned multipurpose tracked platform delivered to a Support Forces military unit. The associated article image is presented in this exact GCS context, giving primary-source identity evidence.

entries.source_title: ‘Iron Soldiers’: A multifunctional ground robotic system could reinforce the capabilities of our military units
entries.author_rightsholder: Manufacturer / Ministry of Defence of Ukraine publication
entries.identity_evidence: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defence article dated 21 June 2025 explicitly identifies the Ukrainian-made TERMIT unmanned ground robotic system, says the new tracked iteration was codified and authorized for operational use, and lists configurations including mine laying. The article marks its image as provided by the manufacturer. Manufacturer Tencore's current Termit 2.0 page independently describes the modular tracked platform and its engineering mine-laying module, corroborating platform identity and engineer role.
entries.license_evidence: The Ministry of Defence article states that the photo was provided by the manufacturer, while the Tencore product page presents product imagery. Neither reviewed source demonstrates a compatible open redistribution licence for repository rehosting; manufacturer-provided/publicly downloadable imagery is not assumed to be openly licensed.
entries.import_blocker: Exact TERMIT/Termit 2.0 official/manufacturer image sources found, but compatible open redistribution rights are not demonstrated; no repository copy, READY_FOR_IMPORT or LOCAL_IMAGE claim is made.
